description: In a well-order of uncountable cofinality, a set belongs to the club filter exactly when it contains a club.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.mem_clubFilter.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α]
  (hα : Cardinal.aleph0 < Order.cof α) (A : Set α) : A ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.clubFilter α ↔ ∃ C, IsClub C ∧ C ⊆ A
